strategic_context.title: A Platform Transformation, Not a Point Solution
paragraphs: PHA's data infrastructure challenge is not a single problem — it is a collection of interconnected constraints that have compounded over time, limiting the organization's ability to serve its members with the timeliness and depth of insight they deserve. Today, PHA's data team operates across a fragmented stack: PHI clinical data submitted through ad-hoc file transfers, financial and operational data collected via manual spreadsheet intake and email coordination, QA and ETL work managed through a combination of SQL scripts, Microsoft Access, Data 360, and Tableau — each requiring significant manual intervention to move data from receipt to report.

The result is a reporting cycle that, in some cases, stretches 12 to 18 months from data collection to published report — a lag that has created real concerns among PHA's membership about the relevance and value of the organization's analytical output. PHA leadership has identified closing this gap as the single most important outcome this engagement must deliver.

Domo addresses this not by replacing one tool with another, but by providing an end-to-end platform — data integration, transformation, AI-powered validation, warehousing, and visualization — under a single, unified environment. This consolidates the existing vendor landscape (Tableau, AWS, Data 360, Access, and custom-built portals) into one governed, scalable system that PHA's team can own and operate independently over time.

pillars.label: Eliminate the Reporting Lag
pillars.text: Reduce PHA's QHR reporting cycle from 12–18 months to near-real-time. Once data is submitted and validated, the report is generated automatically — no manual ETL, no Access intermediary, no multi-month pipeline.

pillars.label: Modernize Data Intake End-to-End
pillars.text: Replace manual spreadsheet collection, email coordination, and ad-hoc file transfers with a governed, member-facing intake platform — covering both PHI clinical data and the four non-PHI financial and operational reports PHA collects annually.

pillars.label: Elevate the Member Experience
pillars.text: Transition members from receiving static annual PDF exports to self-service access to their own data, peer benchmarks, and trend analysis — building PHA's value proposition as a data-driven resource for the PHA community.

pillars.label: Consolidate & Simplify the Tech Stack
pillars.text: Replace the fragmented combination of Tableau, AWS, Data 360, Access, and custom-built portals with a single, fully integrated Domo environment — reducing vendor overhead, training burden, and points of failure across PHA's data operations.

phase_one_framing.title: Solution 1 — QHR Intake Portal: The Right First Step
paragraphs: Within the broader platform vision, Solution 1 has been deliberately scoped to address PHA's most pressing near-term need: establishing a permanent, Domo-native channel for members to submit their QHR PHI data — before the current collection cycle requires PHA to direct members to a temporary solution.

The decommissioned QHR portal left PHA without a dedicated submission channel. An interim SharePoint site has been prepared as a bridge, but directing members there — only to transition them again to Domo within the same year — would create unnecessary friction and require communicating a process change twice in a short period. By standing up the Domo intake portal first, PHA makes one clear, intentional announcement to its membership: this is the new platform, and this is how things will work going forward.

This approach also ensures that every subsequent solution — AI validation, QHR taxonomy mapping, analytics dashboards, and non-PHI form ingestion — is built on a foundation that members are already familiar and comfortable with, making each new capability feel like a natural evolution rather than a disruption.

closing_callout.title: The Defining Outcome
closing_callout.body: PHA's QHR report for 2024 data — collected by the end of Q2 2025 — was not published until early 2026. That is a 9-to-12-month gap between data availability and member access. With Domo's validated intake pipeline and automated reporting layer in place, that same cycle compresses to days from submission. That is the transformation PHA's members are waiting for — and the outcome this engagement is designed to deliver.

solutions.title: QHR PHI Intake Portal
solutions.subtitle: Domo Filesets upload portal · Member authentication · Submission tracking · Replaces interim SharePoint site
solutions.description: A production-ready, HIPAA-aligned PHI file intake portal embedded on phaonline.org. Members log in once, upload their QHR data files, and are done. PHA staff have real-time submission visibility. This becomes the permanent foundation — no interim step, no second migration.

deliverables.title: Member-Facing Intake Portal (Custom App)
deliverables.description: A branded Domo Custom App embedded behind the phaonline.org member login wall. Members access the portal as part of their existing PHA login flow — no second account, no separate URL — and the visual treatment matches PHA's web presence from launch day.
deliverables.outcome_value: Replaces the interim SharePoint upload site and removes the friction that has been suppressing member submissions. Becomes the permanent foundation every subsequent solution builds on — there is no second migration after this.

deliverables.title: Member Authentication & Org Hierarchy Governance
deliverables.description: Role-based access scoping for 150+ member healthcare organizations, including parent-org / child-site hierarchies. Each member organization sees only its own data; PHA staff see across the full membership. Member ID is the authoritative key linking authentication, file partitions, and downstream analytics.
deliverables.outcome_value: Solves the parent/child organization modeling that the current SharePoint setup can't represent cleanly, and gives PHA the HIPAA-aligned access posture required to receive PHI through the portal at all.

deliverables.title: PHI File Upload to Domo Filesets
deliverables.description: A single upload experience that routes member files into Domo Filesets with org-level partitioning. Each member organization's PHI is isolated for HIPAA compliance and is deletable on a per-org basis to honor BAA obligations.
deliverables.outcome_value: Eliminates the upload friction members experience today, while giving PHA a defensible HIPAA posture and a clean BAA-deletability story it can share with member-org legal teams during onboarding.

deliverables.title: EHR Vendor Identification at Intake
deliverables.description: A lightweight intake questionnaire capturing each member organization's EHR vendor (Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, etc.) at the moment of file submission. The captured EHR signal becomes the routing key the Solution 2 AI validation layer applies to choose the correct vendor-specific transformations.
deliverables.outcome_value: Pre-positions Solution 2 with the routing data it needs from day one of the QHR pipeline, so AI validation launches without a separate EHR-discovery exercise after Solution 1 closes.

deliverables.title: Submission Tracker for PHA Staff
deliverables.description: A live PHA-staff dashboard showing Member ID, file name, date/time, and submission status for every org's QHR cycle. Replaces the manually maintained SharePoint tracker PHA staff use today.
deliverables.outcome_value: Restores real-time submission visibility — staff can see who has submitted, who hasn't, and where to follow up in days rather than weeks. Direct support for the solution's 'restore visibility' objective.

deliverables.title: Submission Notifications & Reminders
deliverables.description: Workflow-driven alerts to PHA staff on every new submission, plus configurable reminder cadences for member organizations that haven't yet submitted by the per-cycle deadline.
deliverables.outcome_value: Removes the manual chase-up burden from PHA staff and lifts member submission rates by surfacing late submitters early — the early warning surface that prevents missed cycles before they happen.

deliverables.title: Forward-Compatible Fileset & AppDB Architecture
deliverables.description: Data architecture for the intake layer deliberately designed so that Solutions 2–5 (validation, taxonomy mapping, analytics, extended EHR coverage) plug in additively without rebuilding the intake plumbing.
deliverables.outcome_value: Locks in the 'no second migration' commitment as a structural property of the architecture rather than a hope. The Solution 1 investment is preserved entirely as the program scales across solutions.

deliverables.title: HIPAA-Aligned Environment Configuration
deliverables.description: Configuration of the Domo HIPAA-eligible environment, security review, BAA execution support, and a documentation packet PHA can hand to member organizations and their legal teams during onboarding.
deliverables.outcome_value: Removes the compliance friction that is currently the single biggest block to faster member submission — member-org legal teams clear the portal on day one rather than after weeks of internal review.

deliverables.title: Pilot Cohort Onboarding (5–10 Member Orgs)
deliverables.description: Hands-on onboarding for an early-adopter cohort of 5–10 member organizations, with feedback collection, two iteration cycles, and a phased rollout plan informed by what the pilot reveals.
deliverables.outcome_value: De-risks the full membership rollout — proves the experience works across diverse member-org IT realities before opening it to all 150+. Pilot insights also tune Solution 2's validation rule strictness.

deliverables.title: QA, UAT, and Production Deployment
deliverables.description: End-to-end testing across the upload UX, authentication, fileset isolation, submission tracker, and notifications; UAT with PHA program staff and pilot member representatives; production cutover from the SharePoint interim to the Domo portal.
deliverables.outcome_value: Ensures cutover is a member-experience improvement, not a regression — pilot member organizations move from SharePoint to the Domo portal without losing confidence in the program.

solutions.title: Agentic QHR Validation & Taxonomy Engine
solutions.subtitle: AI validation agent · Human-in-loop workflow · QHR crosswalk · EHR pathway routing · Top 3 EHR systems
solutions.description: With files landing in Filesets from Solution 1, this solution adds intelligence: an agentic review layer that validates data quality, maps to PHA's QHR taxonomy, and surfaces issues to human reviewers before data enters the analytics pipeline.

deliverables.title: Agentic AI Validation Pipeline
deliverables.description: An AI agent that reviews every uploaded Fileset against the QHR required-field checklist, automatically flagging missing, malformed, or out-of-range data before it enters the analytics pipeline.
deliverables.outcome_value: Catches data-quality issues that today only surface 9–12 months later in QHR review — collapsing the remediation cycle from quarters to days and protecting the integrity of every downstream report.

deliverables.title: Human-in-the-Loop Approval Workflow
deliverables.description: A workflow-driven review interface where PHA staff inspect agent findings and approve or reject each data packet before it enters the analytics pipeline. The review queue is filtered to exceptions only, not every submission.
deliverables.outcome_value: Keeps PHA staff judgment in the loop where it matters (edge cases, vendor-specific anomalies) while automating the 80% of submissions that are clean — converts staff effort from data janitorial work to exception handling.

deliverables.title: QHR Taxonomy Crosswalk Engine
deliverables.description: Automated mapping of EHR-specific coding values into PHA's standardized QHR taxonomy. Built on Aaron Cole's existing Data 360 crosswalk scripts and QA logic, ported into Domo with AI-assisted translation so existing institutional knowledge is preserved rather than rebuilt.
deliverables.outcome_value: Preserves five years of institutional crosswalk work and removes the manual Access database / spreadsheet mapping step that today sits between submission and report. The QHR taxonomy becomes a live capability rather than an annual manual exercise.

deliverables.title: EHR Pathway Routing — Top 3 Vendors
deliverables.description: Vendor-aware routing for the three EHR systems that cover ~80% of member submission volume. Each pathway carries the validation rules and transformation logic correct for that vendor's data shape.
deliverables.outcome_value: Delivers immediate clean validation for the membership majority. The long-tail vendors are picked up additively in Solution 5 — no re-architecture required when coverage expands.

deliverables.title: Dynamic Column Mapping Intelligence
deliverables.description: AI detection of EHR column-name changes when a vendor pushes an update, with human approval prompts and confirmed-mapping training so the engine learns from each approved decision.
deliverables.outcome_value: Eliminates the recurring fire drills triggered by EHR vendor updates — historically a major source of QHR cycle delay — and lets the validation engine evolve with the EHR market without consultant rework.

deliverables.title: EHR Transition Dual-Pathway Handling
deliverables.description: Workflow support for member organizations migrating between EHR systems mid-year, ingesting data from both source and target systems without data loss or double-counting through the transition window.
deliverables.outcome_value: Removes a quiet failure mode in today's manual process, where member orgs in EHR transition either submit incomplete data or are quietly excluded from a QHR cycle entirely.

deliverables.title: Field-Level Member Feedback Loop
deliverables.description: Automated notifications back to the submitting member organization when validation issues are detected, with field-level remediation guidance ('Field X failed range check; expected range Y–Z') so the org can self-correct without contacting PHA.
deliverables.outcome_value: Member organizations learn from their own submissions in real time, building data-quality maturity inside the membership and reducing inbound 'why was this rejected?' inquiries to PHA staff.

solutions.subtitle: Near-real-time QHR reporting · Member self-service dashboards · Staff analytics · 12-month lag eliminated
solutions.description: Validated, taxonomy-mapped PHI data flows automatically into the reporting layer — replacing the Tableau + Access + manual ETL pipeline with a Domo-native analytics surface that members access directly.

deliverables.title: Validated PHI to Analytics Pipeline
deliverables.description: Validated, taxonomy-mapped PHI flowing automatically from Solution 2 into the reporting dataset. No manual ETL, no Access database intermediary, no out-of-Domo handoff between validation and reporting.
deliverables.outcome_value: Closes the structural gap that today produces a 9-to-12-month lag between submission and report. The QHR analytics layer becomes a continuous flow rather than an annual data-engineering project.

deliverables.title: Member-Facing QHR Dashboard
deliverables.description: A self-service dashboard giving each member organization access to its own QHR data, anonymized peer benchmarks at category level, and 5-year trend continuity. Replaces the annual PDF QHR report members receive today.
deliverables.outcome_value: Members move from 'an annual PDF emailed 9 months after submission' to 'a live dashboard refreshed in days.' Materially upgrades the value the PHA membership receives — the direct answer to the program's 9-to-12-month gap.

deliverables.title: PHA Staff Aggregate Analytics View
deliverables.description: Full-membership dataset with filter and drill-down by region, org size, Member ID, and EHR type. Reuses the member-portal visualization framework so the staff and member experiences stay visually coherent.
deliverables.outcome_value: Replaces the Tableau + manual ETL workflow PHA staff use today, and enables ad-hoc cross-membership analysis (by region, by EHR type, by org size) that is currently a multi-day manual exercise.

deliverables.title: 5-Year Historical Data Integration
deliverables.description: Five-year QHR baseline aligned to the new schema, giving trend continuity from the legacy Tableau/Access world into the Domo analytics layer. AI-assisted schema translation from historical formats.
deliverables.outcome_value: Members and staff don't lose institutional history at the migration boundary. Year-over-year QHR comparison continues seamlessly, preserving the longitudinal value of every past submission.

deliverables.title: On-Demand PDF Export & Report Generation
deliverables.description: Self-service PDF export from the member dashboard, replacing the current Tableau → PDF → email-distribution workflow.
deliverables.outcome_value: Preserves the PDF artifact some member workflows still require, while removing PHA staff from the manual distribution loop entirely.

deliverables.title: Member-Centered UX Design Review
deliverables.description: Stakeholder design reviews with PHA leadership and a sample of member organizations, deliberately preserving familiar visual language from the legacy QHR report so members aren't asked to learn new conventions while they're learning a new tool.
deliverables.outcome_value: Reduces change-management drag on Solution 3 rollout. Members recognize the report shape from day one — adoption follows the data, not a visual redesign.

solutions.description: This work is sequenced after the QHR PHI portal launch. PHA's financial report data collection is already underway and will conclude within the original six-week window. This solution picks up once the QHR pipeline is established and the member experience is stable.

deliverables.title: Domo Forms — PMPM, Financial, Staffing, Quality
deliverables.description: Domo Forms for each of the four non-PHI data submission types (PMPM, Financial Ratios, Staffing, Quality/Compliance), with required-field validation and field-level guidance per form.
deliverables.outcome_value: Brings the non-PHI data streams into the same submission experience as QHR, ending the multi-tool patchwork members navigate today and giving PHA a unified submission surface across all four data types.

deliverables.title: Tableau Visual Migration (50 Charts)
deliverables.description: Recreation of 36 PMPM and 14 Financial Ratio Tableau visuals in Domo, using the Pacific Drift chart palette and consolidated into 4 dashboards rather than 50 disconnected views. AI-assisted Tableau-to-Beast-Mode translation.
deliverables.outcome_value: Retires the Tableau license dependency for these reports while consolidating 50 fragmented views into 4 coherent dashboards — a usability win in addition to a tooling win.

deliverables.title: Financial & Staffing Member Dashboards
deliverables.description: Dedicated member-facing and PHA-staff aggregate dashboards for the financial and staffing data domains, built on the same parent-app pattern established in Solution 3.
deliverables.outcome_value: Extends the QHR self-service experience into financial and staffing domains, giving members a unified view of their full PHA program participation in one place.

deliverables.title: Staggered Annual Form Activation Calendar
deliverables.description: Form activation tied to PHA's annual data collection cadence — forms become available to members on schedule, and reminders fire on PHA's existing rhythm.
deliverables.outcome_value: Honors PHA's existing operational cadence rather than forcing a process change. Members see forms appearing on the calendar they already expect.

deliverables.title: Extended Member Onboarding Flow
deliverables.description: Member onboarding flow extending the change-management foundation built in Solutions 1–3 across the financial, staffing, and quality submission types.
deliverables.outcome_value: Avoids a second adoption hill for members — the rollout of non-PHI forms feels like an extension of the QHR portal rather than a new system to learn.

solutions.subtitle: All 15 EHR systems · Quality audit engine · Longitudinal tracking · SSO planning
solutions.description: The final solution extends coverage to the full membership and establishes durable quality intelligence — turning every submission cycle into an opportunity for continuous improvement.

deliverables.title: Longitudinal Data Quality Audit Engine
deliverables.description: Per-org tracking of submission accuracy across cycles, surfacing chronic data-quality issues at the membership level. Built on the Solution 2 agent framework and validation logs.
deliverables.outcome_value: Turns every cycle into an opportunity for member-org data improvement rather than a one-time audit. PHA gains visibility into membership-wide data maturity trends and where to invest member support.

deliverables.title: Targeted Member Quality Feedback Packages
deliverables.description: Per-member-org remediation reports surfacing chronic issues — for example, 'Field X is repeatedly submitted late' or 'Field Y consistently fails range checks' — designed to help member organizations improve their in-house data practices.
deliverables.outcome_value: PHA's role evolves from 'collects data' to 'helps member orgs get better at their own data.' Strengthens the member-association value proposition durably and gives member orgs a tangible reason to engage with PHA outside of submission deadlines.

deliverables.title: Extended EHR Pathway Coverage (12+ Vendors)
deliverables.description: Extension of validation and taxonomy mapping to the 12 additional EHR / homegrown systems beyond the Big 3 covered in Solution 2. Repeatable pattern with AI-assisted vendor configuration.

deliverables.outcome_value: Brings the remaining ~20% of membership into the same automated experience as the Big 3 cohort — completing the QHR pipeline modernization for the full membership.

deliverables.title: Predictive Submission Prompts
deliverables.description: AI-generated nudges reminding member organizations of historically missed fields specific to their org and EHR vendor, fired ahead of submission deadlines.
deliverables.outcome_value: Prevents the same submission misses recurring cycle after cycle — turns submission history into a forward-looking quality lever rather than a backward-looking audit artifact.

deliverables.outcome_value: Eliminates the dual-login experience members currently navigate, and pre-positions Domo and the new AMS for a clean integration when the AMS replacement project is ready to execute.

loe_summary.loe_note: AI-Accelerated Delivery: Hour estimates reflect Domo's deepest AI-assisted delivery model. Consultants leverage Claude and Domo AI for custom app scaffolding, Fileset architecture, ETL logic, agentic workflow design, taxonomy engine development, and Tableau-to-Beast-Mode translation — resulting in 40–50% leaner estimates than traditional delivery. Estimates are further compressed by (1) direct reuse of Marcus Brown's existing POC scaffolding into Solution 1, (2) Solution 1 patterns templated directly into Solutions 2–5, (3) parent/child consolidation reducing actual visualization count, (4) Domo platform primitives (Filesets, Magic ETL, Beast Modes, Workflow templates, AI grounding) eliminating bespoke build, and (5) parallel-track execution across solutions. Solution 1 is scoped narrow to hit the late-June target.

implementation_strategy.intro: Mia emphasized that PHA is a member-facing organization and that member experience cannot be compromised. A phased pilot with the most eager or technically capable member orgs — before full rollout — directly addresses this concern and builds confidence at every level of the organization.

pilot_steps.title: Select Pilot Cohort
pilot_steps.description: PHA identifies 5–10 member orgs: the most technically capable, the most eager to submit, or the most trusted to provide candid feedback. These become co-designers of the experience, not just early adopters.

pilot_steps.title: Pilot & Iterate
pilot_steps.description: Pilot orgs complete the full upload experience in the Domo portal. PHA and Domo collect feedback, identify friction points, and refine the experience before broader rollout. Members feel heard and valued.

pilot_steps.title: Sequenced Rollout
pilot_steps.description: Next cohorts onboarded in tranches — 10 to 25 orgs at a time. Issues from the pilot are already resolved. Confidence builds across the membership. No big-bang cutover, no single point of failure.

communication_principles.label: One Transition, Not Two
communication_principles.text: Members are told once: here is the new platform, and here is how you will submit data going forward. No interim step, no second announcement when Domo is ready. Derek confirmed this is the goal.

communication_principles.label: Iterative Reveal
communication_principles.text: Members first see the upload-only portal. Over time, they log in to find new capabilities — dashboards, benchmarks, quality feedback. Change feels incremental and additive, not disruptive.

communication_principles.label: Historical Context Honored
communication_principles.text: Long-tenured members have years of context with how PHA has operated. Communication should acknowledge the change, explain the benefit, and provide clear documentation for both the process and the platform.

communication_principles.label: Documentation First
communication_principles.text: PHA staff must be equipped to field member questions confidently before rollout. Domo will deliver member-facing guides and PHA staff reference documentation alongside each solution launch.

ace_callout.title: ACE Support — Change Management Accelerator
ace_callout.body: PHA's included ACE support package (80 hours/year, 20 hours/quarter) provides direct access to Domo's senior engineers for co-building, training, and platform guidance. During Solution 1 rollout, the ACE team can work concurrently with the implementation team — helping PHA staff learn the platform in real time. Recommended structure: regular office hours blocks (e.g., Monday/Wednesday) so the full data team can participate efficiently without consuming implementation time.

closing_callout.body: If contract is executed by approximately May 15, a team can be mobilized within one week — positioning Solution 1 go-live in late June, before PHA would need to direct members to an interim solution. The full five-solution engagement completes within six months (late November 2026), enabled by parallel-track execution across solutions and AI-assisted consultant delivery. Hours-per-solution are unchanged from the prior plan; calendar duration compresses through concurrent workstreams and overlapping kickoffs (e.g., Solution 2 architecture begins as Solution 1 enters UAT). Solution 1 remains intentionally narrow in scope — upload portal and Filesets governance, no visualization layer — to make this timeline achievable.

methodology.title: Forecast Methodology & Assumptions
items: Audience scale. Member-facing access modeled at 150 member organizations (parent + child sites), with internal PHA usage modeled at ~35 staff users across Quality, Compliance, Finance, and Technology.

Refresh cadence. Submission-driven datasets refresh hourly during active QHR submission cycles and daily otherwise. Analytics datasets refresh nightly. Member-facing dashboards use materialized aggregates rather than live queries against the full member base.

Adoption curve. Year 1 reflects pilot cohort plus the first full member rollout. Year 3 assumes broad member self-service adoption (peer benchmarks, trend views, on-demand PDF). Year 5 assumes the AI-driven Quality Intelligence Center and predictive submission prompts have matured into the day-to-day operational fabric.

What's excluded. Domo platform license fees, ACE/MSP services, Filesets PHI storage overage above the contracted envelope, and any future SSO/AMS integration. These are tracked separately from the consumption forecast.

What drives variability. The Y3/Y5 high end assumes faster-than-typical member self-service adoption (above 60% monthly active member-org usage) and full activation of the predictive AI primitives. The low end assumes adoption tracks Domo's mid-market healthcare benchmark (~35–40% MAU).

current_envelope.label: PHA's Current Annual Envelope (FY26)
current_envelope.note: Year 1 forecast lands above today's contracted envelope, reflecting the substantial new workload this engagement introduces — member-facing portal, AI validation agent, embedded dashboards, and the full reporting pipeline. Domo's recommendation is to right-size the envelope alongside contract execution rather than discover a shortfall mid-Year-1; the Year 3 figure should anchor the multi-year sizing conversation.

recommendations.title: Incremental ETL, Not Full Refresh
recommendations.body: Solution 2 and Solution 3 Magic ETL flows are designed to process only the new submission window on each cycle, not re-run the full historical corpus. This pattern alone reduces steady-state pipeline credit consumption by an estimated 35–45% versus a naive full-refresh design — and it's why the Y3/Y5 Data Pipelines numbers don't grow linearly with member adoption.

recommendations.title: Materialized Aggregates for the Member Portal
recommendations.body: The member-facing QHR portal serves 150 member orgs reading peer benchmarks and 5-year trends. We materialize the heavy aggregates nightly rather than computing them per page-view — meaning a member self-service session is a cheap dashboard render, not an expensive analytics query. This is the single most impactful efficiency choice in the architecture.

recommendations.title: AI Primitive Caching
recommendations.body: Validation agent calls cache by EHR pathway × validation rule version — when 50 member orgs submit using the same EHR vendor in the same validation cycle, the agent reasoning is reused, not re-run. This keeps the AI Primitives line bounded as adoption grows.

recommendations.title: Re-Forecast Triggers
recommendations.body: Re-baseline this forecast at three trigger points: (1) end of Solution 1 — actual member-portal adoption rate observed; (2) end of Solution 3 — measured query/view patterns on the member-facing dashboards; (3) annually — alongside renewal sizing. If any single category exceeds its high-end forecast by 25% or more, escalate to Domo Solutions Engineering for a workload review before the next billing cycle.

directional_callout.title: Directional Forecast — Verified at Solution 1 Architecture Review
directional_callout.body: These figures are a directional forecast based on the architecture proposed in this engagement, the user counts and refresh cadences described in the methodology block, and Domo's published credit consumption model as of contract date. Final sizing is verified during Solution 1 architecture review against actual workloads, and re-baselined at the trigger points listed above.
